changelog: v0.6.1: 1) Native WebAssembly (WASM) Standalone Server AI Pipelines: Whisper STT, SmolLM2/Qwen LLMs, and Piper Neural TTS running 100% locally on PC multi-core CPU without external dependencies; 2) Dynamic PC Model Catalog & Quest 3 Selection: UI settings dynamically query PC models (/api/models) and allow selecting STT, LLM, and Voice models; 3) Agentic Process & Tooling Fixes: Fixed speech matching for natural phrasing, eliminated placeholder replies, enabled server-dispatched 3D world actions.
